conviction_note: The issuer's calendar confirms a 3Q 2026 release on 2026-10-30 at 09:00. The only bar is one public broker preview (Renta 4, 20 Oct: sales EUR155.0m, EBITDA down 34.6% to about EUR15.4m at a 10% margin, net debt EUR390m, cautious guide reiterated), and nothing found says the print will leave it. The lean comes from leverage arithmetic, a weak peer read (Alleima's stalled OCTG business) and this name selling its prints (6 of 8 print days down). Nuclear and Brazil news flow partly offsets it, so p_up is 44 on an abs move of 4.5. Findings sum to -0.7 against a scaled -0.54. Both are small and agree in sign, because no unpriced company-level number was found.

already_public.what: H1 2026: sales EUR323.6m, EBITDA EUR37.9m (Q2 EBITDA 17.9m, 10.6% margin), net debt EUR363.1m at 4.4x LTM EBITDA, backlog EUR1,148m, about EUR20m of working capital tied up by Middle East logistics and called recoverable under the ADNOC take-or-pay contract. Outlook: Q3 hit by seasonality and Middle East, no numeric guidance.

Renta 4's public Q3 preview: sales -5.7% to EUR155.0m, EBITDA -34.6% (margin about 10%), net debt up to EUR390m, backlog stable at EUR1,100-1,150m, cautious guide expected to be reiterated. Price target cut from 4.10 to 3.50.
EDF selects Tubacex (via IBF S.p.A.) to supply forged tubular components for the first two EPR2 reactors. No contract value given.
Q3 2025 comparison base: 9M25 sales EUR525.9m and EBITDA EUR84.6m, implying Q3 2025 sales of about EUR164.5m and EBITDA of about EUR23.6m.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 EBITDA around EUR15m at a margin near 10%, roughly in line with or slightly below Renta 4's bar. Not pre-released.
Net debt up toward EUR390m. LTM net debt/EBITDA likely moves from 4.4x to about 5x. The negative risk is here, partly offset if management dates the ~EUR20m working-capital release for Q4.
No numeric guide exists, and the cautious qualitative outlook is likely reiterated. No change expected.
Backlog, flat to slightly up on umbilical and nuclear orders (EDF EPR2 may be quantified), against peer evidence of a stalled OCTG market. Direction unknown.

bar: Renta 4 Q3 preview, 2026-10-20: sales EUR155.0m, EBITDA -34.6% y/y (about EUR15.4m on a Q3 2025 base of about EUR23.6m), margin about 10%, net debt EUR390m (https://www.bolsamania.com/noticias/analisis-fundamental/renta-4-recorta-precio-tubacex-rebaja-estimaciones-oriente-medio--23891420.html). Single broker source, no second agreeing estimate and no company guide, so every size is capped small. The only consensus found, from July, is stale: FY26 EBITDA EUR105.3m, unreachable after H1 (https://www.bolsamania.com/capitalbolsa/noticias/empresas/tubacex-ante-su-punto-de-inflexion-el-consenso-espera-un-fuerte-salto-de-beneficios-en-2027-y-2028--22939298.html).
session_check: bmo. The issuer's shareholders' calendar lists 'Results Releases: 3Q 2026 Results 2026/10/30 09:00', Madrid time, which is the open. Renta 4 also says the release is 'prevista para el 30 de octubre'. Last year's Q3 release was dated 31 Oct 2025 and the stock moved on that session. Either way the release lands inside close 10-29 -> close 10-30. https://www.tubacex.com/en/investors-shareholders/shareholders-calendar/
positioning_check: Register not covered for this market. The CNMV short-position grid returns no rows and Consulta-OIR returns 403 from this container, so nothing is known about short interest on TUB. This is not a zero. priced_lean_pct (+0.32) is the 20-day run-up (-6.39%) alone, which is also the free control. Only disclosed holder change found: Magallanes became the third-largest shareholder in July 2026 (https://www.bolsamania.com/noticias/mercados/magallanes-tercer-mayor-accionista-tubacex-aflorar-372--22938972.html). Not filed: no in-window mechanism.

findings.finding: The only sourced Q3 bar is a public Renta 4 preview of a weak quarter: sales EUR155.0m (-5.7%), EBITDA -34.6% at a margin near 10%, and an explicit warning that the results 'could hit the share price in the short term'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Print-day close-to-close moves from Yahoo bars: 2024-11-04 -2.2%, 2025-02-27 +0.9%, 2025-04-25 -0.4%, 2025-07-25 +0.5%, 2025-10-31 -2.8% (then +5.3% the next day), 2026-02-27 -3.9%, 2026-04-24 -2.5%, 2026-07-24 -0.8%. That is 6 of 8 down with a median absolute move of about 1.6%, so weak quarters here have drawn small negative days, not collapses.
findings.original_quote: "Prevemos unos débiles resultados en el trimestre estanco, fuertemente condicionados por los sobrecostes logísticos en Abu Dabi derivados del conflicto en Oriente Medio... Esperamos unos débiles resultados que podrían impactar en la cotización a corto plazo" (We expect weak standalone-quarter results, heavily conditioned by logistics overcosts in Abu Dhabi from the Middle East conflict... results that could hit the share price in the short term).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The preview has been public for nine days, and the stock went from 2.715 on 10-21 to 2.71 now, with a -5.3% day on 10-28. What stays open is only whether the print matches a single broker's number. Had the market fully discounted a miss beyond it, the stock would sit at the September low of 2.44 rather than 11% above it.
findings.independence: The company's own H1 outlook says Q3 will be affected by seasonality and the Middle East (https://www.tubacex.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/240726-NdP-Resultados-Tubacex-1S2026.pdf).

findings.finding: Leverage is about to step up. H1 net debt was EUR363.1m at 4.4x LTM EBITDA. If Q3 EBITDA of about EUR15m replaces Q3 2025's EUR23.6m in the LTM and net debt rises to the EUR390m Renta 4 projects, the ratio reaches about 5x+, and the working-capital release the company calls recoverable has not yet happened.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025, when net debt rose to EUR399m (3.5x) on ADNOC working capital: -2.8% on the day and +5.3% the next. Today's balance sheet carries a far weaker EBITDA base.
findings.original_quote: "La deuda financiera neta alcanzó los 363,1 millones de euros, 18,3 millones de euros más que al cierre del ejercicio anterior, situando la ratio DFN/EBITDA en 4,4 veces." (Net financial debt reached EUR363.1m, EUR18.3m above year-end, putting net debt/EBITDA at 4.4x.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The EUR390m figure is public, but no source we found quotes the resulting ratio of about 5x. What the money buys is inventory stuck in transit to Abu Dhabi under a take-or-pay contract, not distress. So the sign is negative only because the release comes before the Q4 unwind. A priced ratio would show up as credit-led selling or as broker notes on covenants, and the search found neither. Asked what the money buys: inventory for ADNOC, recoverable by the company's own statement, which caps this finding.
findings.independence: Renta 4 projects net debt of EUR390m and a Q4 release of the accumulated working capital (https://www.bolsamania.com/noticias/analisis-fundamental/renta-4-recorta-precio-tubacex-rebaja-estimaciones-oriente-medio--23891420.html). That article is also the source for finding 1.

findings.finding: Its closest listed peer, Alleima, reported on 26 Oct that after 'more than eight months of crisis in the Middle East and a largely stalled OCTG market' its Tube division's oil and gas segment weakened further, with a SEK 250m order cancelled. Umbilical, nuclear and aerospace tubing stayed strong.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed case of Tubacex reacting to a peer read-through. Its own prints have turned on volume, the Middle East and working capital.
findings.why_not_priced: Proxy only. Tubacex's E&P is 50% of sales, but its OCTG is dominated by the contracted ADNOC take-or-pay plus Petrobras, so a stalled spot OCTG market reaches it mainly through order intake and backlog, not Q3 sales. On the rest of the company, the strong peer segments (umbilical, nuclear, aerospace) are the ones where Tubacex reported traction in H1, which nets much of this out. Tubacex rose 1.6% on 10-27 after Alleima's report, so the market did not price a read-across.
findings.independence: Tubacex's H1 release reports drilling in the Middle East 'condicionado por un entorno más exigente' and project delays in Process Industry (https://www.tubacex.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/240726-NdP-Resultados-Tubacex-1S2026.pdf).

findings.finding: On the eve of the print, the issuer announced it had been selected by EDF to supply high-integrity forged tubular components for the first two EPR2 reactors, executed by IBF in Italy, with possible extension to more units. No value was given, so the release or the call may quantify it in backlog.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Order news has moved this stock before: it rose almost 7% on its largest umbilical-tube order (Bolsamania), and the ADNOC contract in December 2024 drew a large rally. On 10-29 the EDF award moved it only +0.9%, on 50k shares by mid-afternoon.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the award is public as of today. With no value given, the +0.9% day on very thin volume is the market declining to size it. If the release puts a number on it or on the nuclear pipeline, that is new. If it were fully priced, it would have drawn a move like the 7% umbilical-order day.
findings.independence: The H1 release already cited 'referencias relevantes con EDF' and a first SMR order in Canada, and Bolsamania reported the GE Vernova Hitachi BWRX-300 component order on 16 Jul (https://www.bolsamania.com/noticias/empresas/tubacex-disenara-fabricara-componente-critico-reactor-nuclear-ge-vernova-hitachi--23038258.html).

findings.finding: Petrobras named Tubacex Best OCTG Supplier for the second year running (22 Oct). In H1, the company had said Brazil activity was bringing new orders and greater H2 visibility, which offsets part of the stalled-OCTG read.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None observed. The stock fell 0.9% on 10-22.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a recognition, not an order. Public and small. It matters only if the Q3 release shows Brazil OCTG revenue stepping up as the H1 release implied ('En Brasil, la actividad con Petrobras siguió avanzando, con nuevos pedidos y una mayor visibilidad para el segundo semestre').

outside_window.finding: Q4 2026 release of the ~EUR20m of Abu Dhabi working capital (take-or-pay), forecast by the company and by Renta 4. A cash and deleveraging catalyst after this window, unless the release dates it.

searched_and_found_nothing: CNMV OIR / Información Privilegiada for Tubacex in Sep-Oct 2026: CNMV refuses (403). WebSearch surfaced no OIR or guidance revision before the print, only the 29 Jun OIR announcing the H1 date (marketscreener).
Issuer CNMV mirror page (https://www.tubacex.com/en/investors-shareholders/cnmv/) shows only the EDF and Petrobras news items for October, no pre-release.
Post-H1 consensus for Q3 or FY26 from a second source (Bankinter, Sabadell, Kepler, Santander): none found. Kepler's last public action was a January 2026 downgrade to hold at 3.50.
Cause of the -5.3% move on 2026-10-28: no company or press item found. Bolsamania's 27/28 Oct technical column only describes a weak chart (resistance 3.465, support 2.44). Worth 0.
ERE / collective redundancy: none in 2026. The only labour item was a 2025-2029 collective agreement signed 4 Jun 2026.
Positioning: CNMV short register unreadable, as recorded in the baseline.
Cinco Días and elEconomista not tried (403 measured); Expansión not separately needed after Bolsamanía carried the broker preview.

rejected_candidates.candidate: July 2026 consensus FY26 EBITDA EUR105.3m, implying a large Q3 miss
rejected_candidates.detail: Pre-H1 consensus, superseded by the H1 release (EUR37.9m EBITDA in H1) and by Renta 4's 20 Oct cut. It is not the bar the market now holds.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Middle East / Hormuz disruption continuing through Q3 2026 (ADNOC vessel attacks, renewed closure)
rejected_candidates.detail: Folded into finding 1. The disruption is already the premise of Renta 4's bar and of the company's H1 outlook, so filing it separately would count the same fact twice.

baseline_tension: Mildly with the lean. The run-up is -6.4% over 20 days and -10.9% over 60, the lean +0.32 is the run-up itself, and the findings lean slightly negative on a mostly priced weak quarter. Nothing found is orthogonal to the run-up and decisive.
language_note: The only sourced Q3 bar (Renta 4: sales EUR155.0m, EBITDA -34.6%, margin about 10%, net debt EUR390m, cautious guide reiterated, results date 30 Oct) came from Spanish-language Bolsamanía. No English source carried it.

The H1 net debt/EBITDA of 4.4x and the ~EUR20m recoverable working capital tied to ADNOC take-or-pay were read in the Spanish 'Nota de Prensa'. The English presentation carries the same figures, so the Spanish half added speed, not facts, on this point.
Bolsamanía's ticker news page surfaced the Magallanes stake and the 27/28 Oct technical column. Neither appeared in any English result.
The English side (issuer site and Alleima's MFN report) carried the EDF EPR2 award, the Petrobras recognition and the peer OCTG read that the Spanish press had not yet picked up.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the public Renta 4 bar finding went from -0.3 to -0.2.

'Cash can outweigh a raised guide / look at working capital': the leverage finding went from -0.4 to -0.6, since cash and net debt are the line most likely to surprise on a print with no guidance change.
'A narrow proxy loses... macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis': the Alleima read-through went from -0.4 to -0.3, net of the segments where Tubacex is strong.

'Right about the number and too small about the move': abs_move_pct went from 4.0 to 4.5, because the quarter is not pre-released and the name has thin turnover in the 3-7 band. It is held well under the 7.4% 'new numbers' base because no guidance change is expected (2.3% base) and the name's own observed print moves run a median of about 1.6%. The reaction history stayed in p_up (44), which was not moved twice.
